metadata.question: Does vegetation cover increase in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan from February 23, 2020 to April 29, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user wants to analyze vegetation cover change in the Taklamakan Desert near Hotan between February 23, 2020 and April 29, 2020. Strategy: 1. Location: Taklamakan Desert near Hotan (coordinates ~37.1°N, 79.9°E) 2. Time period: Feb 23, 2020 to Apr 29, 2020 (about 2 months) 3. Data: Sentinel-2 is good for vegetation monitoring with NDVI 4. Approach: Calculate mean NDVI for each date and compare Important considerations: - Desert environment means sparse vegetation, so need to be careful with thresholds - Cloud masking is crucial - Need to check for valid data in both time periods - Use NDVI = (NIR - Red) / (NIR + Red) Steps: 1. Define geometry around Hotan 2. Get Sentinel-2 imagery for both dates 3. Calculate NDVI for each 4. Compare mean NDVI values 5. Check if there's a statistically significant increase For validation: - Check collection sizes - Check pixel counts after masking - Validate NDVI range (-1 to 1) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const hotan = ee.Geometry.Point([79.9269, 37.0998]); // Hotan coordinates const region = hotan.buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Hotan const date1 = '2020-02-23'; const date2 = '2020-04-29'; const dateRange = 7; // ±7 days window // 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-2 for vegetation monitoring function getSentinel2Collection(startDate, endDate) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)); } // Cloud masking function function maskClouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // NDVI calculation function addNDVI(image) { const ndvi = image.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); return image.addBands(ndvi); } // Get collections for both periods const col1 = getSentinel2Collection( ee.Date(date1).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(date1).advance(dateRange, 'day') ).map(maskClouds).map(addNDVI); const col2 = getSentinel2Collection( ee.Date(date2).advance(-dateRange, 'day'), ee.Date(date2).advance(dateRange, 'day') ).map(maskClouds).map(addNDVI); // Check collection sizes const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 2020 Images: ${size1}, Apr 2020 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Create median composites const img1 = col1.median().select('NDVI'); const img2 = col2.median().select('NDVI'); // Calculate mean NDVI values const stats1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const ndvi1 = stats1.get('NDVI').getInfo(); const ndvi2 = stats2.get('NDVI').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels const count1 = img1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2 = img2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`Feb NDVI: ${ndvi1?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${count1}`); console.log(`Apr NDVI: ${ndvi2?.toFixed(4)}, Pixels: ${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Validate calculations if (ndvi1 === null || ndvi2 === null || isNaN(ndvi1) || isNaN(ndvi2) || ndvi1 < -1 || ndvi1 > 1 || ndvi2 < -1 || ndvi2 > 1) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Determine if vegetation increased (threshold = 0.01 for desert environment) const increase = ndvi2 - ndvi1 > 0.01; console.log(`NDVI Change: ${(ndvi2 - ndvi1).toFixed(4)}`); if (increase) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
